makeup_failure_scope: unit_isolated: one unit's makeup line failure does not interrupt the other units' water intake; multi-unit scenarios are concurrent independent unit-level failures, NOT a common-cause source outage
energy_gap_definition: positive integral of terminal-Pg minus actual total Pg; not EENS
shed_semantics: shed_action_total_mw = sum of per-stage shed actions (legacy accounting, may exceed system load and is NOT an unserved-energy figure); shed_peak_mw = largest per-stage cumulative shed; neither is EENS/MWh; UFLS MW reported separately
hard_failure_definition: modelled_hard_service_loss: H = 1[F3_deenergized_only]; F1/F2a voltage states and F2b unresolved AC collapse do NOT count; NOT physical equipment damage
h_load_definition: load-weighted hard-service-loss ratio = sum(PD_MW over H buses) / sum(PD_MW); reported alongside H_count because buses carry unequal load
impact_class_definition: N3 = F3 only, i.e. aligned 1:1 with H>0; N0 = no hard service loss. Class is an operational label, not a severity rank, and is not interchangeable with H
time_definition: t_first_H_s = elapsed seconds from t=0 makeup interruption to the first cascade stage that produced any F3 bus; blank if H=0
solver_warning_note: numerical-health audit of the AC power-flow path that computes shedding and frequency; False means internal convergence is NOT proven and derived secondary quantities are conditional on this limitation (H=F3 itself is a topological determination)
